correctness.rationale: On six exact rational source intervals, both maps have identical target-image unions and identical absolute derivatives, differing only by orientation of two restrictions. Direct affine pushforward gives the same transition Q and uniform conditional target densities under both maps. Induction with conditioning on any previous atoms proves the stationary Markov law for every fixed environment. Eigenvalues 1,0,-1/3 yield covariance and its finite sum; finite-state irreducible aperiodic Markov CLT has asymptotic variance 75/512. The standalone rational checker independently checks all 3888 four-step environment/history cylinder values, stationarity and sample covariance/variance identities; the analytical conditional-uniformity induction handles unbounded lengths. Excluded endpoints have zero mass.

originality.rationale: Compared the full originating same-object text and subsequent stronger-domain rational-cutoff Markov-partition paper. Prior literature explicitly provides the maps, h and one-digit frequency, but not common conditional Q under arbitrary fixed environment nor all finite digit word laws and quantitative correlations/CLT. The quantitative theorem is not logically implied by marginal stationarity or merely having a finite Markov partition. Six semantically targeted published research queries found no matching result, and closest indexed records concern distinct dynamical models. Residual priority risks are acknowledged.
residual_risks: Unindexed or older literature may have derived the common transition Q or an equivalent symbolic conjugacy without Lüroth terminology.
Finite Markov partitions are known from arXiv:2101.01982; distinguishing originality is the exact switching-invariant law and sharp quantitative consequences, not existence of a Markov partition.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The full stationary digit-string distribution is a natural object in number expansions. Here even an arbitrary deterministic environmental schedule is invisible to every digit cylinder law under the natural invariant density, yet the digits are not independent: covariance alternates and decays with a sharp rational coefficient, and the exact counting fluctuations have a nonzero CLT variance. This provides exact serial-dependence benchmarks and reveals a structural equal-image mechanism not captured by the previously known marginal frequency.
